headline: Midland Fronts Churn as Outwich Ranch and Marban Hollow Trade Hands
war_summary: Since our last dispatch, the lull in Linn of Mercy proved fleeting, erupting into eight fresh base turnovers across Outwich Ranch and Lathair while extracting over a thousand casualties in two hours. To the east, Marban Hollow remains ablaze with four rapid shifts centered on Checkpoint Bua as Warden and Colonial losses accelerate steeply. Palantine Berm matches this fierce tempo, recording four fresh exchanges between Vendett and Windburn Landing. In Weathered Expanse, bitter struggles around Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest produced five further changes of hands amidst steady enlistment surges. A sudden northern flare in Nevish Line logged three base transitions across Blinding Stones and Grief Mother, while Farranac Coast saw Warden arms wrest control of Transient Valley under severe fire. Conversely, the earlier fury in the Gutter and Morgens Crossing has tapered off into relative quiet, shifting the war's gravest attrition back toward the central corridors and fractured border strongholds.
